title: Environmental Protection Act (EPA), 1986
definition: An umbrella legislation enacted under Article 253 of the Constitution to provide a framework for the coordination of central and state authorities, established in the wake of the Bhopal Gas Tragedy.
importanceInUpsc: EPA is the 'parent' act for various rules (EIA, CRZ, Hazardous Waste). It is frequently tested for its constitutional basis, delegated legislation powers, and its role as an 'Umbrella Act'.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Environmental Protection Act.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
